bodyHtml:
Project expertise

Software ecodesign and performance experts at the service of your project

Don't want to use Greenspector Studio on your own? Our partners and experts use it to provide you with the best level of support.

Support for ecodesign on a redesign, functional and technical design review, RGESN audit: we intervene according to your priorities.

Contact us to speak directly with our team or our certified partners.

Discover our partners

Projet build

Ecodesign on a build project

We support you throughout the project on two complementary axes:

  • Requirements, objectives, design: anticipate
  • Results measurement: observe

At each sprint, you have the keys to steer or reorient the project towards its target. A final assessment then validates the result achieved.

Define your objectives, then achieve them with a measurable trajectory.

Green IT consulting

Expertise upstream and downstream of your projects

We bring our expertise on the structural topics of your responsible digital transformation.

  • Eco-responsibility of the editorial charter and editorial efficiency workshops.
  • Awareness and training of IT and business teams on mobile and web best practices, with RGESN audit.

Certificate

The Greenspector Digital Service Efficiency Certificate

The certificate is awarded to mobile applications and websites that successfully combine energy efficiency, data efficiency and user performance.

  • Energy efficiency on user device: inclusion, quality and impact reduction.
  • Data consumption efficiency: easier mobile usage and reduced impact.
  • Performance: lower footprint and better UX.

Measurements are analysed then converted to scores and an ecoscore from 0 to 100. The certificate is awarded at Bronze (50-69), Silver (70-89) or Gold (90-100) level.

A badge usable internally and externally is linked to an authentication page hosted by us.
